prompt: Animate this handcrafted museum cut-paper archaeology scene with restrained, realistic motion. Preserve the exact vertical mechanism: saline earth in the upper wooden tray, one wooden funnel beneath it, and the clay jar centered below. The thin teal brine must flow downward through the earth and funnel and terminate only inside the jar opening. Add subtle liquid shimmer, a few drifting salt particles, gentle paper-depth parallax and a very slow controlled dolly-in. Keep the apparatus shape, alignment, colors and object count stable. No text, labels, logos, new objects, extra containers, liquid flowing toward the viewer, liquid missing the jar, object morphing, camera shake, abrupt cuts or dramatic zoom.
